sentences.text:
Order 
This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 482 of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of anticipatory bail relating to FIR/Crime No. 382/2024 dated 4.10.2024 registered at Police Station Mandi, District Sehore for the offence punishable under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code.
2. The counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.

As per prosecutrix's own statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C.,
the applicant and the prosecutrix came in touch in November, 2021.
They were in friendship and later on they had physical relations as well.
The prosecutrix is a major lady aged about 29 years and the applicant is aged about 34 years.
The applicant is ready to co-operate with the investigation and NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:995 2 MCRC-56365-2024 trial.
Trial would take considerable time to conclude, therefore, the applicant be enlarged on anticipatory bail.
3. The counsel for the State has opposed the application and submitted that there is direct allegation against the applicant, therefore, the applicant is not entitled for anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: 4. Heard the submissions and perused the case diary.

5. Looking to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. and the age of the prosecutrix as well as the applicant, this Court finds it to be a fit case to release the applicant on anticipatory bail.
Therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case, the application is allowed.

6. It is directed that in the event of arrest, the applicant shall be enlarged on anticipatory bail on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting Officer/trial Court concerned for his appearance before him during the course of investigation or before the trial Court during course of trial, as the case may be, during the pendency of trial.
7. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 482(2) of the Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
